body: Owner 7 Nov 2026 (D-64): 'using a 30 second preview is really a bad idea, it has caused so many issues previously, do not do that, just take the hit and run and load the full song.' Decided: previews are removed at the source (long-press, plain-server preview, the clip guesses); a song that cannot be played says so in words. Built after the proof pass's first runs; walked on the next release-candidate pair.
